meta.name: alien_farm_invasion
meta.prompt: A small farm town being invaded by aliens.

programs.brief: A colossal dark metallic alien dreadnought hovering ominously over the town center, ribbed hull plates with glowing cyan energy seams along its underside.
A disc-shaped alien scout craft embedded at an angle into a smoking crater, torn outer hull sections and exposed alien conduits.
An angular alien drop capsule punched into the ground, scorch marks around its landing thrusters and a cracked hatch emitting soft light.

tokens.event_direction: alien craft and landing pods descend from the sky over the outer fields, moving toward the town center
tokens.infra: crop_circle pressed into the crop fields; quarantine_fence ringing the perimeter; barricade_line across the road into town
